note: Canonical expected set of foundation documents for Ablo Studio's marketing context layer. The source of truth is the markdown files in `source` (Obsidian/Brain); build.py reads them and embeds body + status into live.strategy. This registry defines WHAT a complete foundation looks like (so a doc that does not exist yet shows as a gap). Each doc's own frontmatter `status` is the live truth; `missing` means no file exists for a registry entry.
